resources.string: Start or stop a meeting recording
Lock the screen. It keeps recording.
Recording keeps going with the screen off or while you use another app. You can stop, pause or mark a moment from the notification or the widget without unlocking.
The mic has heard nothing for 45 seconds
Usually something is covering the mic, or another app is using it. The recording is still being saved.
Anything you record now is saved and transcribed as soon as the download finishes. You don\'t have to wait here.
Every meeting and transcript as one file you keep.
Adds the meetings from a Meeting Transcript backup. Nothing already here is replaced.
Recommended. The transcript is kept. Only the recording is deleted, and only after it has been transcribed.
Gives you time to fix the number of speakers before the recording is deleted. Separating voices again needs the recording.
Every meeting, transcript and recording on this phone.
Records a meeting and turns it into a transcript with timestamps, all on this phone. No account, no upload, works in aeroplane mode.
The rules about recording other people depend on where you live and work. Following them is up to you.
Asks if you want to keep going, and pauses if you don\'t answer. Stops a recording from running on after everyone has left.
Transcribes the meeting as it goes, so a long recording is mostly done by the time you stop. Turn this off if the phone slows down.
Splits the transcript by voice. Often wrong with more than two or three people. It can merge two people into one, or give words to the wrong person.
Downloading… It keeps going if you leave this screen.
Speaker labels are still in testing and are often wrong. Two people can be merged into one, and words can be given to the wrong person. Treat them as a hint, not a record of who said what.
Listening… A rough transcript appears here as people talk. The accurate one is made when you stop.
The live preview needs the speech models. Your recording is fine. It will be transcribed once the models are downloaded.
Name it while you still remember
If you skip this, the app names it from the first words of the transcript.
Optional. Helps with speaker labels, which are still in testing and often wrong.
A one-tap widget starts and stops recording without opening the app.
One tap to start or stop a recording.
Your home screen doesn\'t support adding widgets from an app. Press and hold the home screen, choose Widgets, and find Meeting Transcript.
Microphone access is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings to record.
Only %1$s free. An hour of recording takes about 115 MB, and recording stops by itself when less than 100 MB is left.
Stop the recording before deleting it.
%s\n\nNothing is backed up anywhere, so this can\'t be undone. Copies you exported are not affected.
%1$s of %2$s so far. It continues by itself when the phone is on Wi-Fi.

Everything runs on this phone, so the models have to be stored on it.

• Live preview: %1$s. A small, fast model that shows rough words while you record.
• Accurate transcript: %2$s. The model that writes the transcript you keep.
• Speaker models: %3$s. Only used if you turn on Identify speakers.

Downloaded once. After that, the app works in aeroplane mode.
Recordings will now be transcribed on this phone.
%s, one time only. After that, transcription runs entirely on this device. No account, no upload, works in aeroplane mode.
Starting… It keeps going if you close the app.
%1$s of %2$s so far. The connection dropped. It will pick up where it left off.
Stopped after several tries (%s). What already downloaded is kept, so it won\'t start again from zero.
About %s left to download. Wait for Wi-Fi and it starts by itself when the phone connects, or use mobile data now.
Tap Record when the meeting starts. The audio and the transcript stay on this phone.
Searches meeting names and transcript text.
Copied. Paste it into any chatbot.
Waiting for the speech models. It will be transcribed once they\'re downloaded.
Waiting its turn. It starts by itself, so there\'s nothing you need to do.
This meeting is still being recorded.
Based on speaker labels, which are still in testing and often wrong. Treat these numbers as rough.
The transcript appears here as it is made.
The recording was cut off because the app or phone stopped during the meeting. What was recorded is kept. Go back to the list and it will be transcribed.
Lines appear below as each part is done. It keeps going if you leave this screen.
The phone paused it partway through. It will pick up where it stopped.
Takes a minute or two. The words stay the same. Only the speaker labels change.
Who did most of the talking?
The recording was deleted after transcribing, so voices cannot be separated again.
Turn on Identify speakers in Settings, or fix the speaker count, to see who talked how much.
